translation: If one does not follow this method of treatment, later a residual affliction of the joints will certainly remain. <ins>Climbing rope (攀索)</ins> (Instrument 4) The climbing rope means hanging a rope at a high place and climbing it with both hands. <ins>Stacked-brick instrument (疊磚器)</ins> (5) Stacked bricks means taking six bricks, stacking three on each of the left and right, and standing on them with both feet.
